response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riskandmargin AS r WHERE r.ordervault = o.recordvault) GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.order_count) AS avg_above_average_count, AVG(tc.order_count - overall.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tc.order_count > overall.avg_count
